<!-- Included by report.qmd. Shares its params. Per-survey indices vs the compiled index:
filter to one cruiseseries, build a survey-specific mesh and grid, compute the index, and
compare with compare_surveys(). -->

```{r survey-section, eval=params$include_survey}
#| output: asis
cat("## Survey comparison\n\n")
fit_total   <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "model-fit-total.rds"))
index_total <- readRDS(file.path(out_dir, "index-total.rds"))

sc <- compare_surveys(
  data          = fit_total$data,
  compiled_index = index_total,
  compiled_model = fit_total,
  surveys        = cfg$SURVEYS,       # one index per cruiseseries
  newdata        = grid,
  survey_col     = "cruiseseries",
  mesh_cutoff    = cfg$MESH_CUTOFF_KM
)
print(plot(sc, type = "index"))
print(plot(sc, type = "scatter"))
```
